tei:div.tei:p: (oṃ)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs rje btsun nā ro pas mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra yo gi nī sā dha na/ bod skad du/ rdo rje

stong pa rnal 'byor ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa ni/ ma'i mo rtags 'dzin pa/ sgrub thabs/ thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// dang po re zhig bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor pas dang po thun tha ma la nyal lugs gang yang rung ba'i nyal ba'i rnal 'byor bya/ de nas gnyis pa tho rangs ḍā ma ru'i sgras bskul te ldang ba'i rnal 'byor bya/ de nas gsum pa bdud rtsi myong ba'i rnal 'byor byas la phyi rol gyi mchod pa dang 'brel ba'i dus su rnal 'byor pa'i mdun du maṇ+ḍal bya/ 'di phyi mchod dang 'brel bas 'dir mi dgos so/ / bzhi pa tshad med rnal 'byor ni/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bde ba la dgod par bya'o/ sems bskyed gcig la bzhi ka tshang*/ /zhes tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor sngon du bya'o// de nas lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi bla ma spyi bor bsgom par bya'o// de'i rjes la drug pa bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams la/ der/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra warna nī ye ham̐'u phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba lugs las bzlog par bsam mo// dbus ni bam̐ yig dmar po go /de'i 'od zer gyis rang gi lus khyab pa rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa yongs su dag pa na/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo'i sku de bzhin nyid kyi rtags zhal gcig bden pa gnyis kyi rtags phyag gnyis ma/ thugs rje'i rtags sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ rigs lnga'i rten phyag rgya lnga'i rgyan dang ldan pa chos 'byung gi nang du 'khor ba la mi gnas pa'i rtags sna tshogs pad+ma dang khro mo mtshon pas nyi ma'i gdan la

g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed dang*/ g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan zhabs kyis mnan pa/ g.yas na rdo rje pad+mas mtshan pa'am 'dam ka yin gsungs te ḍā ma ru dang bcas pa gang rung 'dzin par bsam/ dang gri gug g.yon bde ba chen po byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo thod pa dang mchan khung du/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga phrag par bkal ba'i tshul du 'dzin pa/ de nas slar yang brgyad pa dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i byin gyis brlab pa'i rnal 'byor/ yig 'bru'i tshogs kyi 'od zer gyis dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs thams cad dang sems can thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur byas la/ spyan drangs te bdag nyid la gzhug par bya'o// bdun pa/ yang de'i 'od zer gyis 'gro ba 'di sngon la byas la de nas dus gcig tu bsdu gsungs/ thams cad dag par byas nas rje btsun ma'i skur bskyed la/ slar log ste sngags kyi phreng ba nyid la zhugs pa dang*/ dgu pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor/ yid ngag gi dbye bas bzla bar bya'o// de ltar yid bzlas byed na 'dom du chos 'byung bsam/ de la sngags kyis bskor bar bsam/ de nas rlung bsdoms te de la dmigs pa bdun bya/ rgod na yid bzlas bya/ de las skyo na ngag bzlas bya/ ngag gi bzlas pa 'ba' zhig byed na snying gar gtod par bya gsungs so// de nas bcu pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor/ bam̐ yig gi 'od zer gyis sa gsum dang lus dang*/ yi ge rim gyis nā da stong par bsam/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa la zhugs pa sngon du 'gro bas de kho na nyid bsgom par bya'o// bcu gcig pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni thun mtshams su rgyan dang phyag mtshan med par byas la bya ba thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal gyis bya'o// phyi mchod kyang bya'o// thun tha ma la seng ge'i khri'i steng du nyal bar bsams la bla ma steng gi thad kar bltas te phyag byed par bsams la/

bskyed rim la mos pa che na de ltar bya/ de lta min na bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang la nyal lo// las dang po pa'i bsgom pa mdor bsdus pa slob dpon nā ro ta pa'i zhal gyi gdams ngag brgyud pa'i rjes su gnang ba rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ma ti'i zhal snga nas dang*/ dge bsnyen pradzñā kīrtis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// ༈ / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi chos skor sa chen gyis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs pa las thog mar byin rlabs kyi yi ge bzhugs sa ོ// ༈ /dpal bde mchog 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje slob dpon oṃ gsum ma la bsnyen pa song ba gcig gis/ tshes bcu la sogs pa dus khyad par can rnams kyi dus su tshes bcu'i mchod pa'i rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du gnas yid du 'ong bar phyags dar bya ba/ rten bkram bum pa dang sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa dang gtor ma nang gi sbyin sreg yo byad rnams/ bshams/ bum pa gcig cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du bcas la las thams cad pa bzlas/ me long la chang dang bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar bas byug cing sin+dhu ra ras rtsags kyis btab pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mchod pa'i rten gru gsum nyis brtsegs dang*/ dga' ba 'khyil pa mdun rgyab spangs pa'i/ grwa rnams su bya/ dbus su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i snying po gser gyi myu gus bri/ dkar gong gi steng du thod pa chang gis bkang ba bzhag de'i steng du sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal la dar dmar pos bkab la bzhag go /yang 'bras zan la ting lo dri ma ma shor ba chung ngu gcig slob ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa byas la/ de nas bdag bskyed ni rnal 'byor pa gral la 'khod pa la me tog phul te lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba btab/ lha'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par byas sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal skad cig gis rnal 'byor mar bskyed la go cha bkod/

gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs la dbang bskur dbu rgyan rang chas su bsams la/ sangs rgyas la mchod par bya/ phyi nang gi dam tshig can la gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ 'dir gnyis ka byin rlabs byas te so sor lū hi pa'i bzhin bya gzhan 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa gnyis so sor mi shes na 'bru gsum byin gyis brlabs te phaiṃ gyis 'das pa spyan drangs la a ra lis dbul/ a ra li'i spyan drangs la khā his 'jig rten pa la dbul/ dus gcig la gtong la bar 'dir tshogs la rol bar bya/ de nas 'jig rten yi ge brgya pas bshags pa bya/ pa'i gtor ma gshegs la lhag gtor/ de nas slob ma'i gdong g.yogs te/ maṇ+ḍal byas nas bla ma la phul nas gral rim du 'dug pa la/ bum gsol ba btab pa 'dir mdzad/ chu dang las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis bsangs/ de nas tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar bla mas bshad cing bsgom du gzhug slob ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsams la/ de'i lte bar phag mo tshon gang pa cig bsams la/ de chos 'byung du sngar gyis lta bu'i g.yon du 'khor bar bsam/ dpral bar dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du 'khor bar bsam/ de yang dang po slob mas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob dpon khyed kyis bdag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub rnams stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab/ de nas slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis kas rdo rje phag mo dmar mo mar me'i rnam par dmar hril li li song zhing byon par bsams la/ mar me rdo rje phag mor bsams la/ chung ba de 'bar bzhin du slob ma'i khar gzhug go de gyur mid byas pas lte ba'i phag mo la thim par bsgom pa ni lhan skyes kyi phag mo ye shes kyi phag mor ngo sprad pa yin no// de nas phag mo de yar khyug mar khyug byed par sgoms shig byas la rang gi sarba bud+dha bzlas shing ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dkrol/

de sku gsung thugs babs pa'i rtags 'phar g.yo dang ca co smra ba dang mi rtog pa skye ba 'byung ngo*// de nas lte bar rang bzhin gyi phag mo lus la lte bar aṃ yig gi rnam par yod pa de ltar bsgom pa ngo sprad pa yin no // sngar bstan pa ltar gnas par bsam mo// de nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i snying po lan gsum bla ma'i rjes su bzlas pas lung blangs/ slob ma'i rgyud la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnas pa yin par bstan la/ de'i sgom bzlas chag tu mi rung bar gdams pa bstan no// de nas mngon rtogs rnal 'byor bcu gcig po dang phyi mchod dang mkha' spyod sgrub lugs ngo mtshar gcig bshad/ de nas sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal gyi sngags la slob dpon gyis srin lag gis reg ste slob ma'i snying kha mgrin pa smin mtshams su byugs la dbang gsum gyi dod yin zhes bstan/ maṇ+ḍal 'og gi thod pa'i chang yang lag pa g.yon du khyor gang byin la 'thung du gzhug bum pa'i chu yang thigs pa re sbyin/ de yang rnal 'byor pa brtson 'grus rab dang 'byor pa rab kyis tshe 'di la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang 'phrad nas mkha' spyod la 'khyer te/ bud med kha dog dmar ba skra ser zhing grol ba de lta bu dang 'phrad nas bsnyen bkur byas pas mkha' spyod du 'khyer ro// brtson 'grus 'bring la sogs pa ni laṅka li zhes bya ba'i shing sbubs stong pa yod par sin+dhu ra blugs la der dur khrod du sbas la/ tshes gnyis nas bco lnga'i bar du nub re bzhin de'i steng du bzlas bsgom bya/ de nas bton nas rdzas de la yang nas yang du mchod pa rgya chen po byas la/ de nas rang gi dpral bar dga' ba 'khyil pa byas la/ de nas 'khar ba aṃ tshugs byas te grong khyer rnams su 'khyams pa dang*/ bud med gang gis dpral bar dga' ba 'khyil ba byung ba de'i zhabs la 'jus pas/ des mkha' spyod du 'khyer ro// brtson 'grus dang 'byor pa tha mas skye ba phyi mar rnal 'byor ma dang 'phrad nas mkha' spyod du 'khyer ro// tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis la sogs pa la bu mo gzhon nu ma la

ma tshor bar ston mo bya ba yang dam tshig go/ ༈ / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs rnal 'byor bcu gcig phyi mchod mdor bsdus dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub pa'i thabs la/ don bcu gcig gis nges par bya ste/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myong*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /de la dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ bskyed rim la mos pa che na nyal ba'i dus su seng ge'i khri chen po bsgom la/ de'i steng du rnal 'byor ma'i sku rgyan dang cha lugs med par bsgom/ de steng du bla ma de la phyag 'tshal bar sgoms la nyal lo// gu ru puṇ+yashris bris pa gcig la snang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor bsgoms nas de'i ngang nas nyal la/ ma bsgoms na skad cig gis stong par bsgoms la nyal lo// gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ nam mkha' la ḍā ma ru'i sgra nye ba'i snying por grags pa tsam gyis rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang bar bya'o// gsum pa bdud rtsi myong ba ni/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig mchod pa'i bsam pas 'bru gsum brjod cing myong bar bya'o// de la rab ril bu gsum/ 'bring gnyis/ tha ma gcig myong bar bya'o// med na chang hub gsum btung ngo*// bzhi pa tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ bdag gi rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral bar bya'o// zhes bsam ste/ de la tshad med pa bzhi tshang ngo*// lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/

nam mkha' la rin po che'i khri la bla ma dar la babs pa'i cha lugs rus pa'i rgyan drug dang bcas pa ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa bsams la/ de la dkon mchog gsum bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ gyi rang bzhin yin snyam du dran cing gus 'dud drag po bya'o// drug pa lhar bskyed pa ni/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bam̐ yig dmar po de'i mtha' dmar sngags kyi phreng ba oṃ sarba bud+dha sogs kha dog dmar po g.yon bskor du bkod la/ de las 'od zer byung bas lus kyi phyi nang thams cad 'od zer gyis gang ste/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag pas lus shel gong dag pa bzhin du gyur pa las/ rje btsun ma gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar bskyed de zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyang ba la ḍā ma ru 'phyang ba/ g.yon thod pa gyen du 'phyar ba la zhal gzigs pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga phrag pa g.yon la khur ba/ skra grol ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar po dang g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo la bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can du bsam mo// yang na 'di ltar bya gsungs te/ snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od byung bas bdag gi rgyud dag par byas/ de nyid phyir 'phros pas 'gro ba dag par byas te rje btsun mar bskyed/ yang sngags phreng gis 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams spyan drangs te bdag gis lus la bcug nas byin gyis brlabs pa las rang rnal 'byor ma bskyed gsung ngo*/ gsal gdab bo// bdun pa 'gro ba dag par bya ba/ yang sngags phreng las 'od zer byung ste/ ba spu'i bu ga nas song*/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas/ de thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa dag par bsam zhing*/

rje btsun ma'i skur bskyed do// brgyad pa dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor mas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ yang 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad dang*/ 'gro ba rnal 'byor mar bskyed pa thams cad kyang bdag gi ba spu'i bu ga nas bsdu zhing thim par bsam mo// dgu pa bzlas dang po ci nas yid bzlas byed// de la skyo na ngag bzlas byed// yid bzlas 'ba' zhig byed pa'ang yod// gsung pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ ngag gi bzlas pa byed pa na/ snying ga'i sngags phreng la dmigs nas bzlas pa bya/ yid bzlas ni/ don la rdzogs rim mtshan bcas te/ de yang bde ba skye bar 'dod na/ gsang gnas su chos 'byung nyis brtsegs sam rkyang pa gang rung dmar seng nge ba bsgom/ de'i chos 'byung bsnol mar bsgoms nas mdun rgyab spangs pa'i zur gyi grwa rnams su dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi yang dmigs la/ dbus su bam̐ yig la sngags phreng g.yon skor du bkod la/ de la dmigs te rlung mnan cing 'og rlung yang bskum ste/ de lta bu'i yid kyi bzlas pa bdun nam/ de ma byung na lnga'am/ de ma byung na gsum bya'o// phyis goms pa dang rim gyis grangs mang du bya/ drod dang bde ba skye zhing 'phar g.yo drag tu byung na yang rim gyis slod/ mi rtog pa don du gnyer na lte bar bya'o// du ba la sogs pa'i rtags rnams thams cad kyang 'di nyid las 'byung ngo*// bcu pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od 'phros pas/ khams gsum thams cad 'od zer gyis gang*/ de yang gzugs med khams lus kyi stod

mgrin pa yan chad kyi cha la/ gzugs khams bar lte ba yan chad gyi cha la/ 'dod khams smad rkang mthil yan chad gyi cha la/ rang yang sngags dang zla ba la/ zla ba'ang sngags la/ de bam̐ yig la/ de thig le la/ de nā da dkar dmar du gyur te chu la rlabs thim pa ltar ci yang mi dmigs par bsams la/ de'i ngang la shes pa glod de de la ji tsam gnas tshad du gzhag go /zhi gnas shas che na lha'i ngo bor ldang ngo*// gsal ba dang bde ba shas che na stong thun tha ma yin na de'i ngang la nyal/ par bzhag go /de nas ldang ba ni skad cig gis snga ma ltar rgyan dang*/ phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang ngo*// bcu gcig pa spyod lam la dngos dang*/ thun mtshams su tshogs bsags pa dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor bzhi las/ dang po rang dang snang ba thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur dmigs la/ lha la lhas mchod par bsam pa sku'i dga' ba/ de yang sgyu ma lta bu'i sku dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang las ma g.yos par dran par bya ba thugs kyi dga' ba/ sgra ci grags pa thams cad ngag gi bzlas par bya ba gsung gi dga' ba ste de ltar don bcu gcig go /sa spyod lam la 'phros pa'i rim pa 'di 'di'i gnyis pa thun mtshams su tshogs bsags pa ni phyi mchod mdor bsdus byed na/ dus rgyun du'am tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis la mchod pa lnga dang nang mchod gtor ma gcig bshams/ 'khar ba'i snod gcig mdun du bzhag med na sa'i maṇ+ḍal legs par bya la/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par byas te/ ngag bzlas cung zad bya/ de nas chang byin gyis brlabs la/ 'bru gsum brjod cing*/ mtheb srin sbyar la chos 'byung g.yon skor du bri/ thog mar 'bru gsum mthar hoḥzhes brjod pas bdud rtsir bsam/ de nas 'khar ba'i snod la 'bru gsum brjod cing lag pa g.yon pas chang ngam de med na tsan+dan la sogs pa/ g.yon skor gyi chos 'byung gcig bri/

de'i dbus su bam̐ zhes brjod de srin lag reg pas der gdan zhig skad cig gis bsam/ rang gi lte ba'i bam̐ las bam̐ yig gcig chad de gdan gyi steng du song bas rnal 'byor ma rang 'dra ba bskyed de/ de la phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams bsdus la gnyis su med par bstim/ de'i steng gi cha la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can bsgom de la sngags brjod cing phyag bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ de nas mchod pa re re'ang 'dod yon lnga'i lha mo dang ldan pa'am yang na stong pa'i ngang las dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams gang par bsam/ de nas mchod pa dang po bla ma la mchod/ de nas badz+ra yo gi ni badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis lngas mchod/ bla ma la 'bru gsum rnal 'byor ma la/ snying po nyid kyis nang mchod kyis mchod gtor ma phul/ de nas gzhan gyi don mi byed na/ sngar bzhin snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'phro 'du bya/ gzhan don byed na lte ba'i sngags phreng gnyis kyi 'phro 'du la dmigs nas bzlas pa bya/ bzhi pa kha zas kyi rnal 'byor la ni/ kha zas la mtheb srin gyis reg cing 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs/ de nas snying ga'i bam̐ yig de rnal 'byor mar bsams la/ g.yon gyi kun spyod kyis za'o/ bzhi po de dag spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor te rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyin zhag gcig gi bya ba thams cad bstan no// de nas a mṛ tas khrus byas pa'i slob ma chang gi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du tsog pur bzhag ste/ dngos po kun la ma chags pa'i blo bskyed/ bla ma la gus pa bskyed du gzhug de nas bla ma'i lte ba'i sngags las 'od dmar po byung ste slob ma'i lte bar zhugs/ lte ba'i sngags phreng dang bam̐ yig las 'od steng du langs te haṃ gzhu bar bsam/ dpon slob gnyis kas de bzhin du bya/ bla mas nye snying cung zad bzlas/

ḍā ma ru'i sgra bag tsam res 'jog tu bya/ gzhan mi bya/ spogs chog med/ bdud rtsi'i bsrung ba bya/ khyod la chos sku'i rtogs pa bskyed pa yin no// zhes yid ches bskyed/ de nas tshogs la rol/ gzhan don mi byed na gtor ma btang la tshogs la rol/ tshogs med na'ang de bzhin bya/ 'di bdud rtsi myang ba nyid kyis bsrung bar 'gyur gyi/ bsrung ba gzhan med/ dpal nā ro pa'i gsung ngag bdud rtsi lta bu'i don/ dha byang chub sems dpas bkrol ba'o// ༈ / bskyed rim la brten nas mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i yi ge bzhugs so// ༈ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// bskyed pa'i rim pa'i cha lag bzlas bsgom rnam pa gnyis la brten nas mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa ni/ yum rdo rje phag mo la brten pa ste/ de la dang po bla mas lhan cig skyes pa'i phag mo a thung yin gyi ye shes kyi min gsung ste slob ma la/ bstan cing ngos bzung ba la mchod cing gsol ba gdab/ slob ma la yang yi dam du bstan nas/ slob mas kyang tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la brten du bsam pa'i sin+dhu ra dang bu mo gnyis ka la mchod cing*/ bzlas bsgom yun ring du byas shing bsgrubs pas/ rnal 'byor pa dam tshig dang ldan zhing bsod nams rab yin na/ rnal 'byor ma mi mo'i gzugs la brten te rnal 'byor pa mkha' spyod la sogs par byin gyis rlobs par mdzad de/ de'i rtags ni mi mo gang zhig sha dang mig dang skra la sogs pa dmar ser du 'dug cing dpral ba na sha'i ri mo dga' ba 'khyil ba lta bu yod pa de lta bu dang 'phrad na/ de ni rnal 'byor ma yin pa'i rtags yin te/ de la g.yon nas bskor ba gsum la sogs pa'i mchod pa dang*/ maṇ+ḍal dang tshogs dang snyoms 'jug gis mnyes par byas/ gsol ba btab na tshe 'di nyid la mkha' spyod du 'khyer ro// gal te de lta bu'i tshul gyis grub par ma gyur na/

rnal 'byor pa bsod nams 'bring po yin te des sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal byin rlabs kyi skabs bzhin bris la snying po dang nye snying*/ sgrub pa'i tshul gyis bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bzhi bskyal la/ de nas sin+dhu ra'i rdul gyis ma gos pa la sogs pa sgrub pa brtsams par bya ste/ laṅka bod du do rgod pas gtub gsung*/ li ya zhes pa'i sbubs can yod de/ de sor bzhi'am yod na sor brgyad pa cig tshes bcu rnam gnyis gang yang rung ba cig la blangs khang par phyin la/ te rnal 'byor ma la tshogs kyi mchod pa bya zhing de lag tu thogs la stong rtsa brgyad bzlas so// de nas yar gyi tshes bcu la/ sin+dhu ra'i phye ma btsags shing gser gyi myu gus chos 'byung dang sngags ni sarba bud+dhā bri gzhan sngar dang 'dra/ dang dga' ba 'khyil ba bris te rten de la mchod cing bstod do bzlas pa la gsol ba btab la/ sin+dhu ra gong du bsags pa'i sin+dhu ra rnams bsres la/ bsdus te sngags bzlas pa'i shing gi sbubs bkang la/ steng 'og gi bu ga la cha'am/ spra tshil gyis bkag la/ sgrub pa'i grogs mchog sum+bha ni bzlas pa gcig dang dur khrod du phyin la sin+dhu ra dang bcas pa'i shing de dur khrod kyi sa brkos pa'i nang du bcug ste de'i steng du bdag nyid bsdad bsgom du med gsungs/ nas bzlas pa ci nus byas la/ sa phyogs de bsrung ba byas la bzhag de nas bdag nyid bsam gtan gyi khang bur log la ji lta ba bzhin du bzlas so// de nas tshes bcu gcig nas bco lnga'i bar du ni nam sum cha dur khrod du phyin la bzlas/ de nas tshes bcu drug nas nyi shu'i bar du ni nam phyed phyed du bzlas so// de nas nyi shu gcig nas nyi shu bzhi'i bar du ni nam sum gnyis sum gnyis su bzlas so// de nas nyi shu lnga'i tshe ni mtshan thog thag tu bzlas so// skya rengs dang po shar ba dang sin+dhu ra bton la bsam gtan gyi khang par song ste yum rdo rje phag mo la mchod

tshes bcu'i mchod pa rgyas pa dang 'dra/ cing gsol ba btab ste/ de la nang ma re re bzhin bzlas bsgom dang mchod pa la sogs bsgrub pa ji lta ba bzhin byed cing bdag nyid kyi dpral bar shing de'i gsham du bug pa btod de sin+dhu ra 'dzag par byas la des bri ba'am yang na lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis/ sin+dhu ras dga' ba 'khyil ba bri zhing*/ bdag nyid sa la 'dug pa'i bang tshod dang mnyam pa'i dbyug pa gru mo gnyis sprad pa'i sor mo brkyang ba dang mnyam pa tshad yin gsungs/ gcig la sum+bha ni'i sngags mang du bzlas pa cig la rnal 'byor gyi dbyug par byin gyis brlabs la/ de thogs la nang ma re re bzhin sin+dhu ra'i ri mo dpral bar dga' ba 'khyil ba bri zhing*/ yul thams cad du 'khyams khyad par du skud pa 'tshong ba'i tshong dus su bud med mang po tshogs pas der 'gro gzhan yang bud med mang po tshogs sar 'gro'o/ par bya'o// 'khyams pas yum rdo rje phag mo dang 'phrad par 'gyur ro// mi mo la sogs pa gang dang 'phrad pa'i dus su de'i rtags ni sin+dhu ra'i ri mo de de'i dpral bar 'phos na de rnal 'byor ma yin pas de la mchod cing bsnyen bkur byas te gsol ba btab pas mkha' spyod la sogs pa'i dngos grub ster bar 'gyur ro// sgrub pa pos de lta bu yang tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par ma gyur na rnal 'byor pa bsod nams tha ma yin te/ bar dor mos pa bskyed na bar dor yum rdo rje phag mo'i zhal mthong zhing mkha' spyod la sogs pa'i dngos grub ster bar 'gyur ro// bla ma dam pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa rdzogs so// ༈ / tshogs kyi mchod pa mdor bsdus kyi yi ge bzhugs so// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs kyi mchod pa mdor bsdus byed par 'dod na/ dang po sngon 'gro la/ gnas/ dus/ rten bshams pa/ mchod rdzas so// de la dang po ni/

gnas khang phyag dar bya/ chag chag gdab/ maṇ+ḍal dang me tog bkram/ thang sku dgram pa sogs bya/ gnyis pa dus ni tshogs bsags par 'dod na yar gyi tshes bcu/ sgrib pa dag par 'dod na mar gyi tshes bcu la bya'o// gsum pa rten ni sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor ram/ me long la chang gis chos 'byung bri/ dbus su me tog zhig bzhag go /bzhi pa ni/ me tog bdug pa mar me gsum g.yon du/ dri dang gtor ma lha bshos gsum g.yas su/ chang phud ni mdun du bshams/ tshogs kyi yo byad ni ci 'byor pa bsham mo// de nas cho ga la 'jug pa ni/ rdo rje slob mas maṇ+ḍal byas te zhu ba 'bul/ thams cad thugs dgongs mthun par gnas par bya/ de nas bla ma la tshad mar 'dzin pa dang*/ bdag nyid la tshad mar 'dzin pa ste/ rje btsun rnal 'byor mar bskyed la sku mdog la sogs bar gsal gdab/ de nas bsdus pa yin pas sngags ci nus su bzlas pas mchod do// lte bar zla ba la oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ mgrin par hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ spyi bor hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag la phaṭa phaṭa dud ka tsaṇ+ḍi kar mos pa bya/ de nas grub na mchod pa lngas mchod/ ma grub na mi dgos/ de nas gtor ma la 'bru gsum bzlas so// dur khrod brgyad po tshim par bya/ de nas tshogs kyi longs spyod la 'bru gsum bzlas la bdud rtsir bsams la phud dbul/ de nas lha mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyod/ de nas sems tshim pa'i yan lag tu glu la sogs pa bya/ bkra shis brjod/ smon lam ni/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te// bden pa de dag gis ni bdag cag rnams// rtag tu rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /lhag ma bsdus la u tsi ṭas btang*/ de nas go cha bcing ngo*// las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o//

༈ / tshes bcu'i mchod pa'i yi ge bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma dam pa rnams dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pas tshes bcu mchod pa yi dam du byed na/ tsan+dan dmar pos lag pa g.yon pas chos 'byung gi maṇ+ḍal gru gsum du byugs/ tsan+dan med na chang gis byugs/ der me tog tshom bu dgod/ de'i steng du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rjegs tshul du bsam la/ dngos su 'byor pa'i mchod pa lnga bsham/ med na sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis dbul/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ grub na maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du me long la sin+dhu ra dar tshags kyis gdab/ lag pa g.yon pas chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bris pa'i mdun rgyab bor ba'i zur bzhi la dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi bri/ dbus su bud+dha la sogs pa bris la sngags dang tha mi dad pas mchod pa sngar dang 'dra/ bshags pa bya/ tshad med pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad par bya snyam pa ni byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar bya snyam pa ni snying rje dang*/ bde ba de rtag tu rgyun mi chad par bya snyam pa ni dga' ba/ 'jig rten pa'i chos brgyad la btang snyoms/ de nas sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho zhes pa nas/ gtor ma yan chad bsgom mo// de nas rnal 'byor pas tshogs chung bya/ de ma grub na yar dang mar gyi tshes bcu la bu mo grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa gsum mam lnga bza' btung gis tshim par bya/ de yang ma grub na snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// nyes pa thams cad 'dag gsungs// ༈ / sbyin sreg gi yi ge bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas/ thab chos 'byung gi dbyibs gru gsum gyi rnam par byas la der shing brtsigs so// de nas las thams cad pa'i thab der shing brtsigs la/ 'byor na mchod pa rnam pa lnga g.yon du bshams/ sreg rdzas g.yas su bshams/

ma 'byor na mchod pa ma bshams kyang btub gsung*/ sreg rdzas la/ dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa'i phyir mar dang til nag po 'ba' zhig bshams/ khyad par du sdig pa zhi ba la til nag 'byor pa thams cad rgyas pa la zho/ tshe rgyas pa la dūr+wa/ nor gyi 'byor pa rgyas pa la 'bru sna tshogs/ dbang du byed pa la mngar gsum gyi ril bu/ drag po'i las gang yang rung ba la dug sna/ khrag sna/ ske tshe dang lan tshwa la sogs bsres pa'am/ yang na drag po'i rdzas gang yang rung ba gcig gis kyang tshar bcad par nus so// thab dang yo byad bshams pa'o// de nas rdzas bshams pa yang g.yon du mchod pa bshams/ sreg rdzas sogs g.yas su bshams/ drag po'i las lta bu yin na go bzlog ste bsham mo// de nas dngos gzhi la 'jug pa ni/ bdag rang rje btsun rnal 'byor mar bskyed/ cung zad spros pa la dga' na me sbar la/ thab tu me lha phyag bzhi pa gzhung bzhin bskyed/ de la mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang sreg rdzas rnams kyang*/ oṃ ag+na 'di la rdzas la sogs pa gsungs/ ye sarba pā paṃ shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsum mam lnga bdun gyi bar du dbul/ yang mchod la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ de nas 'bar ba'i rnam par thim par bya/ spros pa la mi dga' na rje btsun ma nyid mchod pa nas bzung ste lha mnyes pa nyid kyi cho ga ma tshang ba med pa yin

oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa sarba pā paṃ shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā zhes pa gcig pos phul gsungs/ no// sngar me lha mchod na rje btsun ma mchod pa'i rjes la/ skabs 'dir yang me lha la sreg rdzas lhag ma gsum mam lnga la sogs pas me lha mnyes par bya'o// sngar ma mchod na mi dgos so// de nas skabs 'dir dur khrod brgyad la sha khrag dang bcas pa'i gtor ma gcig dbul/ bar chad bsrung bar bcol/ de nas me lha'am rje btsun ma'i zhabs kyi drung nas blang bar dmigs zhing*/ lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis sbyin sreg gi thal ba gcig blangs la rang gi mdzod spur bsku/ yang na dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga gsum du bsku'o// 'di ni bsrung ba'i mchog go /de nas rje btsun ma gshegs su gsol ba'am/ yang na bdag nyid la bsdu'o// ༈ sa)/mar me'i sbyin sreg gi yi ge bzhugs so// ༈ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa gang zhig mar me'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod na/ mar me'i kong bu yangs pa la/ ras dmar mar dkar byugs/ po'i sdong bu'i rnam pa btsugs la me sbar/ 'byor na mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma bshams/ mar me rje btsun bdag dang gnyis ka skad cig gis sa bon tsam las/ ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ mar bskyed/ mdun du til nag bzhag la/ bdag gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur/ mdun gyi til la thim par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ shīn+taṃku ru ye oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye oṃ ag+na ye sarba pā paṃ shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa'ang snang*/ swā hā/ zhes pas til bsregs/ rjes la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ mar me zad pa dang ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ bsdus pas chog sdig pa thams cad 'dag pa'i thabs yin gsungs/

rje btsun gyi zhal gdams gzhan la phan pa'i blos yi ger bkod pa'o// ༈ / gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs rgyud kyi dum bu bzhugs so// ༈ /de nas gnod sbyin ma'i rtog pa bshad par bya ste/ gang zhig bsgrubs pas bskal rgyud tshig yin 'jam dpal gyi rgyud chen po nas 'byung gsungs te de dang mi mthun/ bcud len gyi stobs kyis/ par gnas par 'gyur ro// de la sgrub snang ba'i gnas 'joms pa/ pa'i thabs ni/ mar khu chen po'i me sbar te/ dur khrod kyi gos nang 'di'i don ro ras rang byung khrag gis byugs pa tshangs kyis mo rang gi khog tu byas pa'o// mo 'ongs pa dang lag pa nas bzung ste bsnol gyis phog par bya ba'i phyir gos phyed kyis mo rang la bkab/ phyed kyis bdag nyid kyi sham thabs bya'o// lho phyogs su kha bltas te thun phyed thun bzhi cha nus na zer yang*/ mo byung gi bar du bzlas pa'i stobs kyis mi yong mi srid pas rang gi mi gcig gal che med kyang yong bas so/ gcig tu bzlas par bya'o// de nas lha'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang*/ baiḍūr+ya dang*/ rin po che cung dmar ba dang*/ dung dang mu tig gis brgyan pa'i lus can/ rkang rgyan dang lag pa'i gdu bu ldan pa ma sring mo chung ma khol mo gang dga' ba cig dang po 'ongs nas bya/ dang po ras dgab ste mar me btang la bzhag de ma shi'i bar du/ nyi ma dang po la 'ongs par 'gyur ro// de'i lag pa nas bzung ste me bzlas pa'i don de snyoms 'jug go/ thun bya'o/ brten thabs bzhi las gang mos su brten byung ba dang po ras kyi bkab la bar der smra bcad byas la bzlas pa byas na bar chad mi yong*/ me shi shi bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas dge ba'i gser man cha gcig byin nas 'gro bar 'gyur ro// de bzhin du nyin re bzhin du ste/ zla ba drug gi bar du bya'o// de sngags bzlas te legs par 'grub par 'gyur ro/

/phan yon yar 'gro tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dang*/ zla ba'i steng du 'gro nus 'jig rten dang*/ ri rab kyi steng du 'gro nus dang*/ ti se la bsgom nus dang*/ bzang po rab gnod sbyin dang*/ sa steng thams cad kyis bstod par 'gyur ro// drag po'i 'jig rten thams cad kyis bstod par 'gyur ro// sgrub pa po ni lo brgyad dang bcud len byin pa zos nas bcu gnyis kyi cha byad can du 'gyur ro// skra cung zad mdzes pa'i tshad 'khyil ba dang*/ rlung gi shugs mgyogs dang ldan pa dang*/ thams cad du thogs pa med par 'gyur ro// lha dang lha min thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro// nyams 'ong nges sod pas kyang nyi ma gcig tu sngags bzla bar bya'o// de la sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ na sgrub pa dang gtor ma gnyis ka'i sngags yin bsnyen pa rnal 'byor ma la bskyal/ mo bha ga wā tī wā ra te maṃ k+ṣa a ti pa ta ye a ti ghi ri de hi da ha sa ya swā hā/ tshangs pa'i bu mo'i man ngag dang bcas pa rdzogs so// / ༈ / gnod sbyin mo pad+ma ti'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༈ /gnod sbyin ma yi bcud len dang*// dgos pa thams cad ster byed pa// pad+ma ti ni yid 'ong ma// khyod nyid la ni phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ pad+ma ti ye swā hā/ gnod sbyin mo myur du 'gugs pa gu gul bdug pa gal che/ tsan+dan maṇ+ḍal mdun du bya// mdun du skad cig gis sgeg pa'i cha byad rin po che'i rgyan can/ yid 'ong dmigs byas la// bcu drug nas bzung nya yi nub// me tog dkar po tsan+dan gyis chus bsgos de la mchod// dkar pos gu gul bdug pa rgyun mi chad// zla ba gcig tu sngags bzlas pa'i dus su smra ba bcad// sha chang 'khrig pa spang bar bya dam tshig tu // bcu drug nas bzung nya yi bar// mchod pa 'byor tshad tsan+dan chus sbags pa'i gtor ma sha khrag la sogs pa

dbul bar bya// phul la pad+ma ti'i mkhrig ma nas bzung la// de la chung ma bsgrub pa gzhan du ni spang bar bya bsam pa'i/ chags pa spyad par bya// grub na nga yi chung ma bgyis zhes brjod// maṇ+ḍal gu gul gyi dud pa de la dbul// ji srid de la ma byung na// zla ba gcig tu yang sgrub mi yong ba yang srid/ bo// bcud len gyis ni dngos grub tshe dang lus dang longs spyod ster// bdag la 'jig rten 'das pa yi// mchog gi dngos grub stsol zhes brjod// thun mong dngos grub gang rung ral gri sogs blangs// de nas spog chog sgrub pa thon nas su// de yi rig pa yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan pos bzung bya zhing*// dus gsum maṇ+ḍal nyi ma re re la dud pa btang*// de ma grub na nyi ma re la lan re 'o// gzhan la chags pa bud med srog la 'ong*/ spang par bya/ /mdzes ma yid du 'ong ba pad+ma ti'i man ngag rdzogs so// ༈ sa)/gnod sbyin pad+ma ti'i sgrub thabs kyi zhal shes bzhugs so// ༈ /rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo// don 'grub ma yi dam byed pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis yid du 'ong ba'i gnod sbyin mo sgrub par byed pa des/ dang po yi dam lha'i sngags la yi ge'i grangs kyi bzlas pa 'bum song ba gcig gis 'di ltar bya ste/ tsan+dan me tog dkar po gu gul dkar po mchod pa rnams sta gon byas la/ tshes 'di'i ming don ni mar ngo'i tshes gcig nas yar ngo'i mthar thug bar sgrub pa'o/ bcu drug gi nub mo nas bzung ste/ zla ba nya'i bar smra bcad byas la bsgrub par bya'o// de yang tshes bcu drug gi nub mo khang pa phyags dar byas te/ der maṇ+ḍal zlum po tsan+dan gyi chus byugs la/ der yi ge kruṃ dmar ser gcig bsam/ de gyur pa tsam gyis yid du 'ong ba pad+ma ti bskyed de/ sku mdog dmar la ser ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/

shin tu sgeg pa mdzes pa/ phyag g.yas na rin po che 'bar ba bsnams pa/ g.yon na rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bsams la/ rang gi lte ba'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gnod sbyin mo bkug ste/ yi ge bzhin dgug gzhug byas la/ de la gu gul dkar po'i dud pa dang me tog dkar po mchod rdzas rnams kyis mchod pa dbul lo// 'di'i dam tshig ni sha chang dang*/ bud med gzhan la 'khrig pa spangs la/ rang rdo rje phag mo'i nga rgyal la gnas pas bzlas pa oṃ pad+ma ti ye swā hā/ bya'o// bya ba gzhan thams cad gzhung bzhin no// bla ma gnyis kyi gdams ngag brgyud pa'i yig chung rdzogs so// ༈ / gnod sbyin mo sgrub pa'i khol po pa ta na'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༈ /'ong nges pas 'jigs pa ci byung yang sngags rgyun ma bcad gsungs/ khol po pa ta na'i u pa ya ni/ shing gcig gi drung du spyil bu phub la/ sgrub thabs bzhin bsgom par bya'o// de yang mi 'dra ba ni hrīḥlas lha mo nag mor bskyed par bya/ rang gi mdun du sha gsar pa'i gtor ma bya'o// mdun du sha chen gyi dud pa btang*/ de yang bsnyen sngags gong ma yin/ la rtags ma byung gi bar du brjod do// rtags ni lus na chil chil 'ong*/ bu yug chen po 'ong*/ rab ni byis pa thod can dngos su 'ong*/ rmi lam dngos su rtags 'ong ba'o// sngags 'og ma sgrub pa la brjod do// gtor ma'ang des sbyin no// ne'u le yin no// oṃ si tra oṃ badz+ra bha ra dha pra ma ra tsa ra karma rak+ṣa ti dza dza bsnyen ba'i sngags so// rtags ma byung gi bar du bya'o// oṃ badz+ra badz+riṃ badz+ra pra ma ra tsa ta ka dhi ma ma pra ya tsa tsha dza dza zhes brjod do// ༈ sa)/lam gyi yan lag pra sen dbab pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru bha dra ya/ lam gyi yan lag pra sen dbab pa'i gdams ngag ni/ rin chen bzhi las nye ba'i snying po yi ge bdun pa sngon du bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bdun cu song ba'i rnal 'byor pa gcig gis bya/

dus ni mar ngo'i tshes bcu shis mod kyis/ yar ngos kyang 'grub ste mtshan mo bya/ gnas ni khang pa gtsang ba bgegs la sogs pa med pa ste/ mi ma shi ba yin na khyad par du dga'/ grogs ni bsam pa mthun pa gsum nas lnga tshun chad tsam/ pra sen dbab pa'i rten gcig dang drug tsam las mang ba mi bya'o// de nas gnas khang phyags dar byas mer sbar bug pa thams cad bkag la bzhag go /der maṇ+ḍal gcig bcas te de la dri'i thig le dang me tog gi tshom bu nang du lnga phyi rol du brgyad de/ lha'i grangs dang mthun par dgod/ tshom bu dbus ma'i steng du bum pa gtsang ma gcig gi nang du rang gi mi bskyod pa 'ba' zhig blugs la bzhag de'i steng du mar nag la ro ras kyi sdong bu btsugs pa'i mar me gcig bzhag g.yon du mchod yon zhabs bsil sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga bshams/ g.yas su dkar gtor gcig dang dmar gtor gcig dang gnyis bzhag mdun du chang la ril bu sbyar la bshams/ yang mthe bong la bsku ba'i rdzas bdud rtsi ril bu dang*/ mar me'i dud pa dang rgya skyegs mar nag rnams legs par bsres pa gcig bzhag bdag gi mdun du maṇ+ḍal gyi pha gar khye'u'am bu mo gtsang ma grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa gcig bzhag la/ de nas sngar gyi gnyis po ma yin pa'i gtor ma bshams la yul phyogs de'i lha 'dre la sbyin par byas la phud gtor/ pra'i gegs ma byed cig byas la gsol ba gdab/ 'byung po spyi la gtor ma sbyin/ bar phud gtor la gsol ba gdab/ de nas bdag gi phung po dang khams dang skye mched lhar dran pa shin tu gal che bas/ de sngon du song bar byas la bdag gi rnal 'byor bskyed par bya ste/ lha mo bcu gsum gyi rnal 'byor ma lū hi pa'i rgyas 'bring gang rung ngam rdo rje dril bu pa gang rung gi rnal 'byor bsgom/ mchod pa rgyas pas mchod/ yi ge bdun pa brgya rtsa bzlas so// de nas mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal stong pa las gzhal yas khang du bsam/

dbus kyi me tog tshom bu dang bum pa dang mar me dang bcas haṃ ngam baṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rdo rje dang thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa ste/ mkha' spyod ma bzhin bskyed/ phyogs bzhi'i tshom bu la lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tam̐ las snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhir bskyed/ phyi rol gyi tshom bu brgyad hūm̐ ring po brgyad la sgo mtshams ma brgyad du bskyed/ go cha bcing ba dang ye shes pa gzhug dang dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab pa dang*/ mchod bstod rgyas par bya ba rnams lū hi pa la sogs pa gzhan dang 'dra/ gtor ma gnyis kyang sbyangs la/ bskyed pa dang dbul thabs gzhan dang 'dra/ dbul ba'i yul ni dkar gtor nang gi rnal 'byor ma lnga la dbul/ dmar gtor ni sgo mtshams ma brgyad la dbul zhig gsol ba gdab bo// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad yod pa byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ dbul ba dang longs spyod pa dang lhag ma'i gtor ma'i bar gzhan dang 'dra bar bya'o// de nas pra rten de dbang ma thob pa yin na/ lhag ma ma thongs kyi bar yol bas bar bcad la phag tu bzhag go /dbang thob na lhan cig bsdad pas btub/ sgrub pa po gnyis kyis ni bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed cing mchod pa nas bzung ste/ cho ga rdzogs kyi bar du gnyis ka'am res mos kyis kyang btub ste/ sgra ma chag par sum+bha ni bzlas pa gal che'o// de nas pra rten de khye'u yin na yum dang bcas pa'i he ru ka bu mo yin na yab dang bcas pa'i rdo rje phag mo/ dam tshig pa bskyed/ go cha bcings/ dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ snyig gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsgom/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab/ mchod yon zhabs bsil sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa dang*/ nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pas mchod/

bstod pas bstod/ yi ge bdun pa mang du bzlas shing*/ pra rten gyi mig la drud mthe bong la bsku ba'i rdzas la yi ge bdun pa mang du bzlas nas mthe bong la bskus te 'od lhag pa bya/ mthe bong gi 'od kyis 'phar rtsa'i steng du dri'i thig le lnga byas la/ lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tam̐ ham̐ dang lnga las nang rnal 'byor ma lngar bskyed/ go cha bcing*/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab cing*/ ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa dbul/ de nas mar me dang dkyil 'khor gyi bar du bcug la mthe bong bstan/ ci mthong ba smros shig gang la yang skrag par ma byed cig ces thog mar bsgos la/ de nas slob dpon smra bcad byas la/ gang dang gang 'dod pa'i don yid kyis dri bar bya'o// de ltar byas na gang 'dod pa'i don mi 'grub ba mi srid gsungs/ rje bla ma lo tsā bas gnyal du mdzad pa'i lo rgyus gsung ngo*// don grub pa dang dal dang maṇ+ḍal dang mthe bong gi lha la mchod pas mchod/ bzod par gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ pra rten dang bla ma kha zas dang nor gyis mnyes par bya/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// pra sen dbab pa'i man ngag go/ ༈ /

sman chen po'i bcud len gyi gdams pa bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// bong nga cha gcig la/ ngan na a ru drug 'gyur/ bzang na bcu gnyis 'gyur bya/ dang po la skam 'thag bya/ de nas dri chu la sbyar la btang*/ snag tsha lta bur mdog nag la mnyen te song ba dang*/ ril bu sran ma tsam bya/ snod du spungs pa'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ de'i dbus su hrīḥphyogs bzhir oṃ āḥhrīḥkhaṃ/ de rnams la bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bar bsam zhing sman rnams bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhrīḥkhaṃ mang du bzlas/ zhag re la re re spel zhing ril bu bcu gcig tshun chad lto sbyangs/ rtag tu bcu gcig bcu gcig bza'/ zla ba re re la a ru ra cha re phri zhing sbyar bas/ bong nga bzang ngan gyis zla ba drug gam bcu gnyis na bong nga rang du 'gro/ bong nga sran ma tsam re za/ zla ba re la bcu gnyis cha'i bag re tsam spel bas/ lo gcig na ril ma tsam du btang*/ zhag re la ril ma tsam re zos pas bza' ba dang bgo ba gnyis ka'i don du 'gro'o// dug nag zi bi ri ba la sogs pa byung na/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor spyi bor bsgoms la/ yi ge las bdud rtsi byung bar bsam zhing lus bkrus/ bdud rtsi'i lus khengs par bsam zhing sngags bzlas so// thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag go/ ༈ / sa chen gyi yi ge rnams kyi bsdus don brag phug pa'i gsung sgros so// ༈ /bla ma nā ro ta pa'i gdams ngag 'di'i skor la bzhi ste/ bskyed pa'i rim pa phag mo mkha' spyod ma dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma dang*/ thun mong gi dngos grub gnod sbyin mo dbang du bya ba dang*/ lam de dag gi yan lag go /dang po la brgyad de/ rjes gnang dang*/ bskyed rim dngos dang*/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la 'phros pa'i phyi mchod mdor bsdus pa dang*/ mkha' spyod sgrub pa dang*/ dus gang yang rung ba'i tshogs mchod mdor bsdus pa dang*/

tshes bcu'i mchod pa dang*/ sbyin sreg rgyas pa dang*/ mar me'i sbyin sreg dang brgyad do// gnod sbyin mo dbang du bya ba la gsum ste/ rgyud kyi dum bu dang*/ pad+ma ti'i sgrub thabs dang*/ khol po pa ta na bsgrub pa'o// lam gyi yan lag la gnyis te/ pra sen dbab pa dang*/ sman chen po'i bcud len no// dum bu 'di dag dril ba la go rim nges pa mi snang ngo*// phyi mchod kyi zhar la rjes gnang dang byin rlabs gcig yod de/ de la phyag len mi mdzad par gda'/ byin gyis brlabs kyi zhar la mkha' spyod sgrub pa cung zad kyang snang ngo*/ /rje sa chen gyi yi ge gong ma'i mchan bu dang bcas pa 'di/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi yi ge'i snying po lta bu med mi rung du yod pas gces spras mchog tu bya'o// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ /edhi/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// bskyed dang rol pa'i yum gyur ma// rdo rje rnal 'byor mar btud nas// de mnyes byed pa'i cho ga bshad// dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la kha nub tu bltas te ci bde bar 'dug nas bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi myangs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsam mo// de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ bde ba dang ma bral ba na ci ma rung snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ bde sdug med pa'i ngang sems snyoms par gyur cig snyam pa'i btang snyoms te tshad med pa bzhi dang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom/ de nas rang gi spyi bor bla ma bsgoms nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma dam pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// zhes brjod cing mos gus drag po byas pas/ bla ma rang gi lus la thim pas snying ga'i nang du chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi lte bar bam̐ la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar dmigs la/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros sems can thams cad la phog pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas de dag thams cad rnal 'byor mar gyur te/ 'od zer slar 'dus te rang la thim pas/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa ni/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma zhal gyen du phyogs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom mo/ /go cha rnams yig 'bru las lhar bskyed pa yod na'ang*/ 'dir nā ro pa'i lugs kyi yi ge nyid lha'i ngo bor bsgom par bzhed de/ a bhi dha na las/ lha nyid sngags kyi tshul gyis ni// dngos grub thams cad ster bar byed// ces so/ /de'i lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hrīṃ moṃ dkar mo rdo rje rmongs byed ma/

mtshan mar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka rnams su bsams la/ de'i thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'dir mchod pa ma byas kyang mi 'gal te/ grub chen lū hi pas/ ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs nas// dam tshig 'khor lo myur du zhugs// ces pa'i 'grel par myur du zhes pa ni mchod pa la ma ltos pa'o// zhes gsungs so/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par bsams nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa de nyid la sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag go /bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshul ni gsum las/ bha ga'i gnas su dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du myur bar 'khor ba zhig bsams nas/ de la dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtad la rlung kha sbyor bsgoms pas bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur ro// yang smin mtshams kyi thad ka'i steng gi nam mkhar dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du 'khor ba la sems gtad de/ yid mnyam par bzhag pas mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro// de yang stong shas che na bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom/ bde shas che na stong pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgoms la/ zung du chud par gyur na dga' ba 'khyil pa de nyid snying ga'i bam̐ la bstim ste mnyam par bzhag par bya'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// sngags bzlas par 'dod na/ snying ga'i bam̐ gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yon skor du 'khor ba'i 'od kyis/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rgyud bskul nas/ de dag gi ye shes bdag gi rgyud la zhugs pas/

sdig pa dang sgrib pa dag tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas par bya'o// gtor ma btang ba'i tshe sha chang dang bcas pa'i gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ thod pa chen po sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs/ de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas nas phaiṃ zhes brjod cing*/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ chos skyong dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams kyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ badz+ra a ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dri sh+ya hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan lnga'am bdun gyis phul nas/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab brten pa// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod nas// lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i tshig yin pas// bden pa des ni lha mo de dag rnams// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces bden pa'i stobs brjod nas gsol ba btab pas/ ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub gnang bar bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod pas gshegs su gsol/ kha zas za ba'i tshe/ kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar dmigs pa'i lte ba nas/

gtum mo'i me sbar ba'i me lce'i khrod du/ snying khar bla ma dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang*/ lte bar 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad dmigs nas/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa bsgoms pa'i lte bar oṃ bam̐ mdun phyogs nas brtsams te 'dab ma rnams la rim pa bzhin/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ bkod pa rnams dpa' mo drug tu dmigs la mchod par bsam zhing*/ thog mar zhu ba'i rdzas dang*/ de nas gong bu'i rdzas rnams kyi mchod pa myos par bsam zhing*/ lag pa gnyis phan tshun mnye'o// de nas lag pa g.yon pas dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar reg pas/ dpa' mo de rnams rang gi lus la thim par bsams nas/ lag pa g.yon pas thog mar phud kyis bla ma dang*/ yi dam mchod la/ de nas kha hoṃ khung du bsgom par phul bas lus kyi lha thams cad mnyes par bsam zhing za'o// de nas oṃ u tsiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swā hā yis lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po thams cad la sbyin no// de nas spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phyi rol gyi snang ba thams cad mchod pa'i lha mor dmigs pa rnams kyis 'dod yon gyi mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ kha na ma tho ba med pa ci bder spyod do// nyal ba'i tshe snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ phyi rol gyi 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bsdus nas rang la thim/ rang gi lus kyang snying ga'i bam̐ la thim/ bam̐ kyang stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang la nyal lo// ldang ba'i tshe stong pa nyid kyi ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa'i thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad gsal bar dmigs nas ldang bar bya'o// de ltar yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor la rtag tu gnas nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis rjes su bzung nas mkha' la spyod pa'i go 'phang myur du thob ste/

go 'phang de nyid la brten nas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// gsung rab zab mo'i snying po'i tshul// rnal 'byor ma dpal sgrub pa'i thabs// dad ldan shes blo gsal ba yi// go go can gyi gsol btab nas// sngags 'chang 'phags pa zhes byas sbyar// dge ba 'di yis 'gro ba kun// dge ba'i dpal gyis 'byor gyur nas// mkha' spyod mchog gi rol gyur cig /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' la spyod pa'i sgrub thabs rje btsun nā ro pa'i man ngag dpal sa skya pa las brgyud pa 'di ni sa mo sbrul gyi lo gdu bu'i zla ba la shang mdor sbyar ba'o// ༈ / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs chung ba 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod ma bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig dga' ba dang bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig mnyam nyid kyi don rtogs nas 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig ces tshad med pa bzhi yun ring du bsgom mo// de nas rang gi snying ga'i nang du yi ge bam̐ dmar po bsgoms pa las 'od 'phros pas/ rang gi sdig pa sbyangs/ phyir 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ 'od tshur 'dus bam̐ yig la thim pas rang nyid rnal 'byor mar gyur pa ni/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du bzhengs pa'i zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas gri gug thur du 'dzin zhing g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa steng du phyogs pa bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ phrag pa la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga khur ba la ḍā ma ru btags pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/

dbu skra nag po sil mar gyur pa/ spyan gsum pa shin tu mdzes pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang la bstim/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de sems mnyam par bzhag go /de nas bam̐ gyi mtha' ma la sngags kyis bskor bas/ rang gi sdig pa dang nad thams cad sbyang bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus pa bzlas so// gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin rlabs pa/ snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs la gtor ma 'bul bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra a ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dri sh+ya hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la/ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol lo// zas za ba'i tshe kha zas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi lus kyi lha mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyod do// nub mo nyal ba'i tshe stong pa'i ngang la nyal lo// ldang ba'i tshe lha skur ldang ngo*// spyod lam thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal gyis bya'o// de ltar rtag tu yi dam du byas na ring por mi thogs pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro// dpal nā ro ta pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs 'phags pas me pho byi ba'i lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swasti/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs sangs rgyas= chos= dge 'dun= sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom mo// rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/ sku mdog dmar po ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag nyid bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma de rang la thim pas rang gi snying gar e yig nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs/ de'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bam̐ yig dmar po/ de'i mtha' mar g.yon skor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bskor te gnas pa'i 'od kyis lus thams cad gang bas/ tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad sbyangs bsregs pas lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur par bsam/ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du 'phyang zhing bsnams pa/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung ste zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/

phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan rnams la lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon po gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka rnams su gyur/ thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ sarba yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ rdzogs rim ni/ gsang gnas su chos 'byung dmar seng nge ba gcig gi nang du dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du gnas pa la sems gtad pas bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye zhing smin mtshams kyi thad du dga' ba 'khyil pa la sems gtad pas mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye'o// bzlas pa ni sngar gyi bam̐ yig sngar bzhin bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi byin rlabs dang yon tan 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ sngags phreng la thim pas bdag gi sdig sgrib dag cing yon tan rnams rgyas par bsams la/ ci nus bzlas/ yid bzlas ni rlung kha sbyar la sngar ltar yid kyis lan bdun bzla'o// de nas gtor ma mi 'bul na dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo'o// rang rje btsun ma'i nga rgyal gyis bya ba gzhan la 'jug go /gnas skabs gzhan du gtor ma btang na/ sha chang gis bsal ba'i gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/

oṃ sum+ha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ gṛh+na gṛh+na hūm̐/ gṛh+na pā ya gṛh+na pā ya hūm̐/ a nā ya ho/ bha ga wan/ bid+ya rā dza hūm̐ phaṭaḥ stong pa'i ngang las aḥlas byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ phaiṃ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang chos skyong dang 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ ad+ya nut+pan na tot+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa gsum/ badz+ra yo gi nī/ sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ pa d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha= dhu paṃ pra tīts+tsha= di paṃ pra= gan+dhaṃ pra= nai wi d+ya= shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ puṣ+pa hits+tsha/ ces nang bdud rtsis mchod la/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mkha' spyod ma dngos grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'khod par shog /'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas kyang*// rol mo dbyangs snyan sil snyan sogs mchod nas// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog /ces pas bsngo ba bya/ badz+ra muḥ

ces pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ gnas skabs thams cad du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni sngags 'chang kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o// ༈ / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub pa'i thabs la don bcu gcig gis nges par bya ste/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myong*/ =/ =/ =/ =/ =/ =/ =/ zhes pa'i dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ srod thun la bsgom bzlas byas nas thun mjug tu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor bsgoms nas de'i ngang la nyal/ ma bsgoms na skad cig gis stong par bsgoms nas nyal lo// bskyed rim la mos na rin po che'i khri'i steng du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'od zer gyi rang bzhin bsgoms pa'i spyi bor bla ma bzhugs par bsams nas de la phyag 'tshal bar bsgoms te nyal lo// gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ nam mkhar ḍā ma ru'i sgra snying po'i sngags su grags pa tsam gyis gnyid bskul te/ rje btsun ma la phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang bar bya'o// gsum pa bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ snying ga'i bam̐ mchod pa'i bsam pas 'bru gsum brjod cing myang bar bya ste/ de la rab ni bdud rtsi ril bu gsum/ 'bring gnyis/ tha ma gcig myang bar bya'o// med na bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs la hub gsum btung ngo*// bzhi pa tshad med pa bsgom pa'i thog mar bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro byas nas/ bdag gi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ sems can thams cad srid par 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral bar bya'o// zhes lan gsum brjod pas sems bskyed par bya'o// lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du/

sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas pas ḍā ma ru dang g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ g.yon gyi gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ sku la phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ lang tsho dar la babs pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ zhes brjod cing bsams la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma 'od du zhu spyi bo nas rang la thim par bsam mo// drug pa bdag lhar bskyed pa ni/ rang gi snying gar e las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar g.yon skor gyis oṃ oṃ oṃ= zhes pa'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi lus thams cad gang bas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rdo rje phag mo sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo bltab nas mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar po bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug kha thur du 'phyang ba/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung ste zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/

gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ mgo bor hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍa li ka'i ngo bo/ bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi sngags phreng las 'od zer dmar po 'phros te ba spu'i bu ga nas phar song rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas/ de thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag de dag thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur par bsam/ brgyad pa dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlab pa ni/ lus kyi 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su lan gsum bskor zhing*/ phaiṃ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang 'gro ba rnal 'byor mar gyur pa thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mādzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad skor gyi mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ yo ga= zhes brjod/ de nas lha'i sku la sems bzung ngo*// dgu pa bzlas pa la gnyis las/ dang po ngag bzlas ni/ snying khar chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig dmar po'i g.yon bskor du sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog dmar pos bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin brlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par bkug sngags phreng la thim pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlabs par bsams la/

oṃ oṃ oṃ= zhes yi dam lha'i nga rgyal gyis byin gyis rlabs kyi bar du bzla ba'am grangs kyi bsnyen pa bzhi 'bum la sogs pa bzlas/ rgyun du ni dam bca' ji tsam yod pa bzla'o// gnyis pa yid bzlas ni/ don la rdzogs rim mtshan bcas te/ snying ga'i chos 'byung zla ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa bde ba skye bar 'dod na gsang gnas/ mi rtog ba skye bar 'dod na lte bar phab ste/ 'og rlung cung zad bskum/ steng rlung mnan la rlung kha sbyar nas/ grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba g.yon du bskor ba la dmigs pa gtad de/ oṃ gsum ma yid kyis bdun nam de ma byung na lnga'am de ma byung na gsum bya'o// phyis goms pa dang rim gyis mang du bya/ drod dang bde ba skye zhing 'phar g.yo drag tu 'byung la/ de byung na rim gyis glod do// du ba la sogs pa'i rtags thams cad kyang 'di nyid las 'byung ngo*// bcu pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od 'phros pas khams gsum thams cad 'od kyis gang*/ de yang gzugs med kyi khams thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par byas nas lus kyi stod cha la thim/ gzugs khams bar gyi cha la/ 'dod khams smad kyi/ rang yang sku stod sku smad rim gyis bsdus nas chos 'byung la thim/ de zla ba la/ de yig 'bru rnams la/ de bam̐ yig la/ de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ de yang je phra je phra la mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las sems glod la ji tsam gnas tshad du bzhag go /zhi gnas shas che na lhar ldang ngo*// gsal ba dang bde shas che na stong par bzhag lhar ldang ba ni sngar ltar rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang ngo*// bcu gcig pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ de nas spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rang dang snang ba thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur dmigs la/ bya byed kyi tshe lha la lhas mchod pa sku'i dga' ba/ de yang sgyu ma lta bu dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang las ma g.yos par dran par bya ba thugs kyi dga' ba/

sgra ci grag pa thams cad ngag gi bzlas par bya ba gsung gi dga' ba ste/ de ltar don bcu gcig go /dge ba 'di yis= gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ byin gyis brlabs la rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chos skyong dang 'jig rten skyong bas bskor ba gsal bar dmigs la/ ye shes pa ro gcig tu byas la gtor ma phul bar dmigs la/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su a kā ro btags pa gsum mam lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ phyi nang gis mchod la/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ =/ =/ =/ =/ =/ =/ =/ dge ba 'di yis sogs dang*/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams su len pa'i tshul rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru rat+na war+dhā ya/ rnam kun mchog ldan shes rab lha mo dang*// mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po la btud nas// rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams len bshad kyis nyon// 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa/ 'di'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga rgyas bsdus gang rung thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ nub mo 'od gsal stong nyid kyi ngang du nyal/ tho rangs ldang ba'i tshe nam mkha' nas ḍā ma ru'i sgra oṃ gsum ma'i sgra sngags su grag pas bskul te/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur gyur par bsams la/ byin gyis rlabs pa'i nang mchod dam/ bdud rtsi ril bu oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas myangs te/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo mchod par bsam/ skyabs yul gsal btab la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus da nas bzung ste/

ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci mang brjod/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya'o// de'i phyir du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ mdun gyi nam mkha' rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag nyid bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma de rang la thim pas/ rang gi snying gar e yig nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las/ chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bam̐ yig dmar po'i tha mar g.yon skor gyis oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bskor te gnas pa'i 'od kyis lus thams cad gang bas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/

phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du 'phyang ba/ g.yon pa thod khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snyig gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas 'od zer phyir 'phros pas/ rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la phog pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs nas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa tshur 'dus te rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su g.yon du bskor zhing*/ thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang la gnyis su med par thim/ pad skor dang bcas pa'i 'khyud rgya byas la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dha rmāḥyo go shud+dho3haṃ/ thugs ka'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros pas/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs te bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim par bsam zhing*/

oṃ gsum ma dam bca' ji tsam yod pa las mi nyung bar bzla/ mthar snying ga'i chos 'byung zla ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa/ bde ba bskyed par 'dod na gsang gnas/ mi rtog pa skye bar 'dod na lte bar phab la rlung kha sbyar te/ chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du 'khor ba la sems gtad cing sngags kyi yig 'bru g.yon skor du gnas pa la yid kyis lan bdun bklag lte ba'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od kyi rnam par gyur te/ gzugs med khams pa lus kyi stod kyi cha la/ gzugs khams bar gyi cha la/ 'dod khams smad kyi cha la/ rang gi sku stod sku smad nas rim gyis 'dus te chos 'byung la/ chos 'byung zla ba la/ zla ba sngags phreng la/ sngags phreng bam̐ yig la/ bam̐ yig mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ nā da yang mi dmigs te 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur par bsam/ ldang ba'i tshe rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang*/ rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag dang 'da' kha'i man ngag yod na 'dir bsgoms la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mkha' spyod ma dpal 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thog nas su// rol mo glu dbyangs sil snyan sogs mchod pas// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su khrid par shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// de chos gsung yang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas// bden pa des kyang lha mo de dag gis// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces sogs smon lam ci shes btab/ spyod lam gyi tshe rang dang snang ba thams cad rje btsun ma'i sku/ grag pa thams cad oṃ gsum ma'i sngags/ sems kyi dran rig thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings las ma g.yos par shes pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi dga' ba gsum dang ma bral bar bya'o// gtor ma 'bul na/

ci 'byor pa'i gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+na pā ya gṛh+na pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ a nā ya hoḥ bha ga wān/ bid+ya rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ phaiṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang chos skyong dang 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmāḥṇaṃ ad+ya nut+pan+na tod oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam lngas phul/ badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pa d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe= dhu pe= dī paṃ= gan+dhaṃ= nai wi d+yaṃ= shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes dang*/ 'bru gsum brjod cing*/ nang bdud rtsis kyang mchod la/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul na skabs 'dir phul la/ rjes chog kyang spyi dang mthun par bya/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams su len tshul 'di yang don gnyer mang pos bskur ba'i ngor ngag 'don rnams bla ma rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung rab gzhir bzhag rnal 'byor lhag ma rnams dpal sa skya pa chen po'i gsung rab nas kha bskang ste nyams su blang bde bar btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis sbyar ba'o//

rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hi/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs rgyun du nyams su blang ba'i ngag 'don gyi tshul ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes sogs brjod/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes brjod/ bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral bar bya/ de'i phyir du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam gyi rim pa zab mo nyams su blang bar bya'o// zhes pa gsum brjod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas bde stong gi sgra sgrogs pa'i ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing gzhon nu lang 'tsho dar la babs pa/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ bla ma 'od du zhu spyi bo nas rang la thim pas/ rang gi snying gar e e las chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mtha' g.yon skor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ lus thams cad gang lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng na mnan pa/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltab nas mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar po bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen la phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon pa la rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku sked yan chad kheb pa/ lang tsho dar la babs shing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas shing*/ bde ba skyed pa'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hrīṃ hriṃ sor mo skyod byed ma/

spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros te ba spu'i bu ga nas phar song*/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas/ sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs/ de thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su g.yon skor du lan gsum bskor zhing*/ ngag tu phaiṃ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ 'gro ba rnal 'byor mar gyur pa thams cad kyang bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa dang*/ pad skor gyi mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ rang gi snying gar chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig las sngags phreng kha dog dmar po g.yon du bskor ba las 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ sngags phreng la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas/ snying kha'i chos 'byung zla ba'i yig 'bru dang bcas pa/ bde ba skyed par 'dod na gsang gnas dang*/ mi rtog pa skye bar 'dod na lte bar phab ste/ mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du 'khor ba dang*/ sngags phreng lan gsum mam bdun la sogs pa klog pa'i tshul du sems gtad nas rlung kha sbyor ci thub 'dzin/

rang gi smin mtshams dang gsang gnas su dga' 'khyil g.yon skor du shugs drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad nas rlung kha sbyar bzung*/ dga' 'khyil gnyis mthar snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim par bsam mo// rang gi snying kha'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum thams cad khyab/ gzugs med khams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam pas lus kyi stod kyi cha la thim/ gzugs khams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pas bar gyi cha la thim/ 'dod khams 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas smad kyi cha la thim/ mthar rang yang stod smad nas rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas chos 'byung la thim/ de zla ba la/ de sngags phreng la/ de bam̐ yig la/ de bam̐ gyi mgo bo la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ de je phra la mi dmigs par gyur/ ces sems ci gnas bzhag de'i ngang nas rang nyid rje btsun ma'i skur gyur/ dge ba 'di yis sogs/ 'chi tshe mgon dang sogs/ zhes brjod/ ces pa 'di ni rje btsun rdo ring pa'i zhabs rdul spyi bos lon pa ban+de blo gsal rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
